topography.project_purpose: Infinite Trading Protocol is a DeFi platform that enables users to create and manage on-chain investment pools, stake tokens, and execute trades across multiple chains. It provides infrastructure for pool management, staking, and asset swapping, with support for AI-driven strategies.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol uses multiple PoolFactory instances (each behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy) to deploy and manage pools, while ITP token and ItpStakingV1 handle staking incentives. VeloOracle provides price data, and all components are linked through shared proxy patterns and upgradeable infrastructure.
